## Checklist

- [ ] Tests are added or updated. A bug fix includes a test that fails without the fix.
- [ ] `uv run ruff check` passes on the changed files.
- [ ] For a change users can see: the docs are updated and `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## Unreleased`.
- [ ] The description says whether the change touches the core `doeff/` API or an optional package in `packages/`.
